usageNote: 动词短语！decide to后面接动词原形，表示下定决心要做某事。比want to更坚定，已经做好决定啦！

examples.en: It was such a nice day that we decided to walk to the cinema instead of taking the bus.
examples.zh: 天气太好了，我们决定步行去电影院，而不是坐公交车。

examples.en: She decided to walk to the cinema to get some exercise before the movie started.
examples.zh: 她决定步行去电影院，在电影开始前顺便锻炼一下。
